notes: Tuition: the fee table does not state a period per fee; the four-digit EUR amounts seen on comparable MATE bachelor fee rows (e.g. 2100-2300 EUR) match a per-semester fee as HUF for the same rows, while the higher EUR figures elsewhere are per year, so 2500 EUR is recorded as the per-semester fee for this programme's English-taught Gödöllő full-time track. The pages do not give an application deadline or say whether a foreign applicant applies directly to the university or via Stipendium Hungaricum, and they do not list the documents an international applicant must submit, so those facts are left out. The 7-semester length (3.5 years) and the tuition row are for the full-time Gödöllő, English-taught track; the Kaposvár track is Hungarian-only.
